name: Web document — Twitter (horizontal)
description: A recognizable X/Twitter status on a transparent overlay, as a clean backdrop for the channel's hand-pulled highlight. Faithful site look BY DESIGN: exact X 'Dim' dark mode (bg #15202b, real action + verified-badge icons, X font stack), inside a browser window whose address bar shows the URL — NO Syntax collage chrome (no torn edge / grit / hard offset shadow), and NO CSS glow on the captured card. The emissive 'web page on a backlit display' look is a TypeGPU shaderPass (subpixel emission, backlight bloom, escaping-bezel halo, viewport-edge defocus), not Pack chrome. ~6s: card settles in, the highlighter draws on over the hero line (~1.2→2.4s), then a long static hold a creator can freeze/extend. Transparent WebM overlay, composited over footage.

content.author: Dev Notes
content.body: Spent all weekend chasing a slow build. Turns out [highlight]the bottleneck was a console.log inside a hot loop[/highlight] — pulled it and the bundle step dropped 4x.
